adversarialProbes.finding: A KNOWN factor explicitly marked pointInTimeEligible=false with availableAt after the decision clock was accepted into a SELECTED frozen decision.
A SHORT_MOMENTUM prediction bundle became outcomeJoinEligible using only a SWING_GROWTH fingerprint, no source-session receipt, and a non-recomputed decisionHash.
A run fingerprint declared COMPLETE/outcomeJoinEligible with source and accounting receipts from different dates and strategies and with zero decision hashes.
A forged resume checkpoint with invalid checkpointHash, zero samples and every requested date pre-marked completed produced allRequestedDatesComplete=true.
Monotonic outcome validation allowed MFE/MAE deletion, holding-session rewrite and outcome/cost JSON replacement under the same decision_id.
An expired entry window containing only incomplete OHLC was finalized as NO_FILL/DATA_UNKNOWN, and reversed execution market dates were accepted.
A future-dated, explicitly non-PIT globalTransmission input became a KNOWN dimension inside a vector marked pointInTimeEligible=true.
The persistence executor accepted an unverified batchHash and executed caller-supplied UPDATE SQL while reporting an INSERTED immutable operation.

findings.title: Frozen decisions can promote explicitly non-PIT or future factor evidence
Outcome-join fingerprints do not enforce decision/source/strategy/version isolation
Immutable persistence executor trusts unverified batch SQL and digest fields
Outcome monotonic updates can rewrite cost/performance provenance and erase excursions
Execution/outcome session validation can misclassify unknown entry windows and accept reversed dates
Bulk backtest can accept forged completion checkpoints and unproven PIT universes
D18 regime vectors can certify future/non-PIT optional contexts as PIT eligible
